user.title: Cloudflare API token
user.description: Create a token at My Profile → API Tokens with permission Zone → DNS → Edit on the zone you want to keep updated.

data_description.api_token: Pasting the whole 'Bearer ...' header works too.

record.title: Choose the record
record.description: Which record in {zone} should follow your public IP?

data_description.record_name: A host such as 'home', the full name 'home.example.com', or '@' for the domain itself.
data_description.proxied: Proxying hides your real address behind Cloudflare, which defeats most reasons to run dynamic DNS. Leave this off unless the name is only used for web traffic.
data_description.ttl: Seconds, or 1 for automatic. Ignored on proxied records, which Cloudflare always sets to automatic.
data_description.update_interval: Minutes between checks. Cloudflare is only written to when the address actually changed.

create_records.title: Create the record?
create_records.description:
No {types} record exists for {record} yet. Submit to create it now, pointing at your current public IP, with proxying set to: {proxied}.

If you would rather create it yourself in the Cloudflare dashboard, do that first and then start over.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Cloudflare
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {record} no longer works. Enter a replacement with Zone → DNS → Edit permission.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cloudflare API.
error.invalid_auth: That token was rejected, or it lacks DNS edit permission on this zone.
error.no_zones: This token cannot see any zones. Check its permissions and zone resources.
error.wrong_zone: That name is not inside the selected zone.
error.no_public_ip: Could not determine your public address, so there is nothing to point the record at.
error.create_failed: Cloudflare refused to create the record. Check the logs for the reason.

abort.already_configured: That record is already set up.

data_description.proxied: Only applied to records this integration creates. Existing records keep their current setting, because updates never touch it.
data_description.ttl: Seconds, or 1 for automatic. Ignored on proxied records.

update_now.name: Update now
update_now.description: Checks the public IP and updates Cloudflare immediately, without waiting for the next scheduled check.

entry_id.name: Entries
entry_id.description: Which configured records to check. Leave empty for all of them.
